integrity: Proof provided and independent finite checks replayable; no external scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Endomorphisms are K-linear; standard symplectic counts are inputs. Exact rank distribution and density transition are proved, but broader bibliographic equivalences cannot be excluded. Numerical tests are not infinite proofs.
scope: Nonunital associative algebras defined by a nondegenerate alternating form on an even-dimensional vector space over any field; full linear endomorphism monoid and finite-field rank spectra.
title: Endomorphism rank spectra and an automorphism-density transition in alternating two-step algebras
